senses.en: An oblong shield made of boards or wickerwork covered with leather, with sometimes an iron rim; -- carried chiefly by the heavy-armed infantry.
senses.zh: 用皮革覆盖的板子或皮革制成的斜盾,有时用铁圈; -- -- 主要由重武装步兵携带。

senses.en: A penthouse or awning.
The second and largest of the four parts forming the upper surface of a thoracic segment of an insect. It is preceded by the prescutum and followed by the scutellum. See the Illust. under Thorax.
senses.zh: 昆虫胸节背面四个部分中的第二个、也是最大的部分；前方是前盾片，后方是小盾片。参见原词典Thorax词条下的插图。

senses.en: One of the two lower valves of the operculum of a barnacle.
